summation.displayName: Activated MAP2K phosphorylates MAPK on threonine and tyrosin...
summation.text: Activated MAP2K phosphorylates MAPK on threonine and tyrosine residues in the activation loop (residues T202 and Y204 in MAPK3, residues T185 and Y187 in MAPK1) (Ray et al, 1988; reviewed in Roskoski, 2012b). MAPK3 and MAPK1 are 84% identical and appear to be stimulated in parallel by all known activators of the MAPK pathway (Lefloch et al, 2009; reviewed in Lloyd, 2006).
